conflicts.permit: We may disclose User Provided and Automatically Collected Information: as required by law, such as to comply with a subpoena, or similar legal process;
conflicts.prohibit: Only aggregated, anonymized data is periodically transmitted to external services to help us improve the Application and our service.
conflicts.situation: Disclosing non-aggregated, identifiable user provided or automatically collected information to external parties under a subpoena or legal process.
conflicts.reason: The policy flatly asserts that only aggregated, anonymized data is transmitted externally, but immediately lists scenarios where identifiable user information is disclosed.
